name: Overbroad universal claim
definition: A sentence says "all", "only", "never" or "outside X nothing", and an inventory, the plan's other tasks or the scope of the enforcing test contradict it.
question_template: Name the set this sentence covers. Find one member it leaves out or contradicts: look at the plan's other tasks, at what the enforcing test skips, and run one count or listing command over the tree.
severity_guidance: Blocking when one counter-example that the document itself shows falsifies the claim; minor when the claim is only loosely worded.
known_weakness: Contradictions that sit in other tasks are not scripted; most recorded instances are delivered documents, not plan text.
